system.title: How ATRA works
system.about: ATRA Health pairs two digital twins for every person. Agents prepare the clinical work inside each twin, and named clinicians make every decision.

ahdt.name: Agentic Human Digital Twin
ahdt.about: Lifelong. It owns the person's body data, models and context through 17 member twins, from the heart to social life. It exists whether or not the person is ill.

apdt.name: Agentic Patient Digital Twin
apdt.about: Opened when a care episode starts at a facility and closed when it ends. It owns the history, examination, tests, diagnoses, prescriptions and decisions of that episode.

system.workflowAbout: What happens to one patient, step by step.

open.title: A clinician opens an episode
open.about: A medical officer, nurse or community health worker chooses the patient and the reason for the visit.

intake.title: The intake is recorded
intake.about: Symptoms, examination findings, measurements and test results become FHIR records of the episode.

reason.title: The reasoner proposes
reason.about: It ranks the differential diagnosis, chooses tests by value and price, checks treatments for safety and simulates them on the patient's twin. Every proposal has an explanation bundle with its evidence and sources.

agents.title: Agents prepare each decision
agents.about: The diagnosis, treatment and care orchestrators gather evidence from the human twin and stop at each decision point.

decide.title: The medical officer decides
decide.about: Accept, edit or reject the diagnosis. Sign the prescription. A prescription with a blocking safety issue cannot be signed until it is changed.

verify.title: The pharmacist verifies
verify.about: The signed prescription reaches the pharmacist's worklist in the same run, to verify, query or reject.

explain.title: The patient sees an explanation
explain.about: Each result in plain words in the patient's own language, with consent and preference controls.

twin.title: The human twin keeps learning
twin.about: Readings from devices and the facility update the member twins, whose agents watch their standing goals.

1.name: Physical
1.about: The person, their devices and actuators, and the clinicians who enter data.

2.name: Network and cloud integration
2.about: The edge service at each facility or home, device transports and store-and-forward.

3.name: Data ingestion
3.about: Validation, unit harmonisation, pseudonymisation, the data stores and the knowledge graphs.

4.name: Model
4.about: Mechanistic body models, trained machine-learning models, and language and speech models.

5.name: Explainable AI
5.about: An explainer for every model output.

6.name: Service
6.about: Data, models and simulation, explanations, cognitive services and the connections between twins.

7.name: Agentic
7.about: Worker agents, orchestrators, the conductor and the external API.

8.name: Application
8.about: This web app, the mobile apps, SMS, USSD and voice.

system.ahdtAgentsAbout: Workers do one job, an orchestrator runs each member twin, and the conductor coordinates them.
system.apdtAgentsAbout: They prepare the clinical work. Every decision stays with a named clinician.

monitoring.name: Monitoring
monitoring.about: Reads the twin's state and when each field was last observed.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.about: Rates how severe the twin's state is.

forecasting.name: Forecasting
forecasting.about: Runs the forecasts that the twin's goals need.

explanation.name: Explanation
explanation.about: Explains unmet goals and outputs at watch or alert level.

recommendation.name: Recommendation
recommendation.about: Proposes support actions listed in the knowledge base, each with its source.

orchestrator.name: Twin orchestrator
orchestrator.about: Senses, updates the state, checks goals, plans, acts, explains and reports for one member twin.

conductor.name: Conductor
conductor.about: Turns a person's care goal into sub-goals, orders the orchestrators and arbitrates between their plans.

history.name: History taking
history.about: Lists the inputs the episode still needs.

evidence.name: Evidence assembly
evidence.about: Gathers readings, medicines, twin states and explanations from the human twin.

differential.name: Differential diagnosis
differential.about: Ranks the diagnoses and builds their explanation bundles.

investigation.name: Investigation
investigation.about: Chooses the tests that would change the diagnosis most for their price.

treatment.name: Treatment planning
treatment.about: Lists the options and simulates the first three on the patient's twin.

pharmacotherapy.name: Pharmacotherapy
pharmacotherapy.about: Checks interactions, kidney function, pregnancy and genome for each dose.

guard.name: Safety and consent guard
guard.about: Checks every agent action before it runs.

system.safety: How the system keeps clinicians in charge
system.safetyAbout: Two independent checks stop an agent from deciding a clinical matter.

guard.name: Autonomy levels
guard.about: Each kind of action has a fixed level, from inform to never. Signing, ordering and dispensing are never allowed for an agent.

human.name: A human at every decision
human.about: The API accepts a decision only from a person with the role the step needs, never from an agent or a service.

consent.name: Consent
consent.about: A person can withhold any kind of data. Every tool call checks the person's consent first.

audit.name: Audit
audit.about: Every request, decision and refusal is written to a hash-chained audit log.

system.membersAbout: The human twin is a federation of these twins. Each owns its models and its standing goals.
system.modelsAbout: Every model has a fidelity tier that says how it was built.
system.servicesAbout: The services behind this app and whether each answers now.
